definitions.gloss: to estimate, to assess, to calculate roughly
definitions.explanation: To roughly calculate the cost, amount, time, or value of something. Commonly used in business for making cost estimates and quotations.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{費用|ひよう}を{見積|みつ}もる。
{被害|ひがい}{額|がく}は{一億|いちおく}{円|えん}と{見積|みつ}もられている。
examples.english: The damage is estimated at 100 million yen.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}を{多|おお}めに{見積|みつ}もっておいたほうが、{安心|あんしん}だ。
examples.english: It's safer to estimate on the generous side when it comes to time.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form {見積|みつ}もり (estimate, quotation) is extremely common in business. It can also be written {見積|みつ}り. The expressions {多|おお}めに{見積|みつ}もる (to overestimate) and {少|すく}なめに{見積|みつ}もる (to underestimate) are frequently used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {費用|ひよう}を{見積|みつ}もる: to estimate costs
- {多|おお}めに{見積|みつ}もる: to estimate on the high side
- {少|すく}なめに{見積|みつ}もる: to estimate on the low side
- ～と{見積|みつ}もられる: to be estimated at...
- {見積|みつ}もりを{出|だ}す: to give a quotation
